summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without running any tests or repository code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans applied last, and the early path skips them; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style so click metadata is preserved; layout resolver needed no change because the Edge protocol already declares min_size. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Nothing was committed. Judgment calls: the bar position maps the active name to its displayed index so duplicate names still underline the displayed tab (acceptance criterion 11), letter search only applies to single-character keys, and zero-width labels are left out of the resolver input. Tests and the demo have not been executed, so they are unverified.
